name: Common bean (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) [Pulses] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 173744 (Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, raw)
Foods 2025 15(2):391 doi:10.3390/foods15020391 (PMC12841103) - soluble sugars/oligosaccharides in 12 P. vulgaris accessions (HPLC-RI)
PMC7439167 - raw red haricot bean oligosaccharides and phytic acid
Punia et al. 2020 Legume Science doi:10.1002/leg3.52 - kidney bean starch review
Massey et al. 2001 J Agric Food Chem doi:10.1021/jf010484y; oxalatecontent.com - legume oxalate content
PMID:8069112 - LC organic acids (oxalic/malic/citric/fumaric) in Phaseolus vulgaris
Sustainability 2021 doi:10.3390/su13126869; PMC9405002; PMC10820859 - Phaseolus seed organic-acid presence
provenance.curation_notes: Curated as the raw mature dry seed (Phaseolus vulgaris). Dominant carbon/energy source is STARCH (~40 g/100g); the growth-relevant free carbohydrate pool is sucrose (~2.6) plus the RFO oligosaccharides stachyose (~2.6) and raffinose (~0.25) - free glucose/fructose are essentially absent in the dry seed. Nitrogen is supplied chiefly by ~22.5 g/100g protein (Glu/Asp/Lys-rich). Organic acids are minor here (oxalic ~40 mg/100g; malic/citric/fumaric present but not reliably quantified in dry seed) -
curation_added: individual sugars with amounts: sucrose, stachyose, raffinose, verbascose, D-galactose, myo-inositol
starch quantified (~40 g/100g) as the dominant carbon source
full USDA quantification of all minerals, vitamins, amino acids and fatty acids

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
